name: API Gateway
purpose: It solves the problem of managing complex, distributed backend services by providing a unified, secure, and scalable entry point for client applications. This centralizes cross-cutting concerns like security, traffic management, and protocol translation, allowing developers to focus on core business logic.
coreComponents: Policy Enforcement Layer (Authentication, Authorization, Rate Limiting)
keyCapabilities: Authentication and Authorization (e.g., OAuth, JWT, API Keys)
Traffic Management (Rate Limiting, Throttling, Load Balancing, Circuit Breaking)
Caching to improve performance and reduce backend load
Monitoring, Logging, and Analytics for API usage and performance
integrations: Identity Providers (e.g., OAuth, OpenID Connect, SAML, JWT)
Backend Services (Microservices, Serverless Functions like AWS Lambda, HTTP/S Endpoints)
Cloud Services (e.g., AWS DynamoDB, Azure Monitor, Google Cloud services)
useCases: Centralized Authentication and Authorization for Microservices
API Aggregation for Mobile and Web Clients to reduce chattiness
Legacy System Integration and Digital Transformation

researchPapers.title: Systematic Review of API Gateway Patterns for Scalable and Secure Application Architecture
The Evolving Role of API Gateways in Scalable Microservices Architecture
